product_overview: A modern portfolio website for showcasing services, selected work, process, and thought leadership. It also provides a contact inquiry form for potential clients to reach out directly.
core_goals: Learn about the developer and their background
Browse services offered and review the delivery process
Explore selected projects and external live sites
Read articles and find answers to common questions
Submit an inquiry through the contact form

features.name: Hero Section and Preloader
features.description: An animated homepage hero that introduces the portfolio with motion-led branding and navigation access.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Watch the loading sequence progress -> See the hero headline and intro content appear -> Open the navigation overlay
Navigate to / -> Watch the rotating words change across the hero -> Observe the animated headline reveal

features.name: Navigation Menu Overlay
features.description: A full-screen navigation overlay that helps users move around the site and access contact details and social profiles.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the navigation overlay -> Choose a site section to browse -> View the selected page
Navigate to / -> Open the navigation overlay -> Select the direct email link -> Start an email message
Navigate to / -> Open the navigation overlay -> Select a social profile link -> View the external profile
Navigate to / -> Open the navigation overlay -> Close the overlay to return to the current page

features.name: About Page and About Section
features.description: Background information about the developer, available both on the homepage and on the dedicated About page.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Read the profile overview and credentials -> Return to another section of the site
Navigate to / -> View the About section -> Follow the 'Let's talk' action -> Reach the contact section
Navigate to / -> View the About section -> Follow the 'See the work' action -> Reach the projects section

features.name: Services Overview and Interactive Services Accordion
features.description: A services area that presents the offerings and lets users expand items to inspect details and previews.
user_flows: Navigate to /services -> Review the listed service offerings -> Open a service item to inspect its details -> View the expanded preview content
Navigate to / -> View the Services section -> Open a service item to inspect its details -> Continue exploring the other offerings

features.name: Selected Work and Projects Showcase
features.description: A portfolio showcase of featured client projects with project summaries and links to live sites.
user_flows: Navigate to /work -> Review the featured projects -> Open an external live website link -> View the client site
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Projects section -> Review a project card -> Open an external live website link -> View the client site
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Projects section -> Select the 'Let's talk' action -> Reach the contact section

features.name: Delivery Process
features.description: A page that explains the staged workflow used to deliver projects.
user_flows: Navigate to /process -> Read the three-stage delivery process -> Understand how work is structured

features.name: Frequently Asked Questions
features.description: A page that answers common questions about the developer's services and working style.
user_flows: Navigate to /faq -> Read the list of questions and answers -> Find information relevant to the project

features.name: Engineering and Design Articles
features.description: A blog page that presents articles on engineering and design topics.
user_flows: Navigate to /blog -> Browse the article list -> Open an article to read more content

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: An inquiry form that lets users send a message and receive confirmation after successful submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name -> Fill in email address -> Submit the form -> See the confirmation message
Navigate to /contact -> Leave required fields blank or enter an invalid email address -> Submit the form -> See inline validation feedback
Navigate to /contact -> Submit an inquiry successfully -> Choose to send another message -> See the form reset for a new entry

features.name: Legal and Policy Pages
features.description: Static pages for terms, privacy, and cookie policy information.
user_flows: Navigate to /terms -> Read the terms of service content
Navigate to /privacy -> Read the privacy policy content
Navigate to /cookies -> Read the cookie policy content

features.name: Inquiry Confirmation Page
features.description: A confirmation page that acknowledges a successfully submitted inquiry.
user_flows: Navigate to /thank-you -> Read the confirmation message -> Return to the rest of the site

routes.description: Portfolio homepage with Hero, About, TechStackCarousel, Services, Process, Projects, ProcessSteps, Contact, and Footer
Selected Work and production systems page
Dedicated Contact page with interactive inquiry form
Inquiry confirmation and thank you page

features.name: Hero Section and Preloader
features.description: Animated preloader sequence, rotating words, Didone gradient headline 'The Best Trick in Business Is a System That Runs Itself.', and iPhone-style animated menu icon
user_interactions: Watch preloader counter animate from 0 to 100
See words rotate through Studios, Films, Stories, Visions, Futures, Concepts
Observe hero reveal and metallic foil headline
Click iPhone style menu icon to toggle navigation overlay

features.name: Navigation Menu Overlay
features.description: Full-screen editorial menu overlay with site links, direct email, location, and social links
user_interactions: Click Menu button in navigation header
Click on any navigation item to browse
Click close icon or press Escape to dismiss overlay
Click email link aruunsomesh@gmail.com
Click GitHub or Instagram profile links

features.name: About Section & CTAs
features.description: Developer profile overview with direct anchor navigation buttons
user_interactions: View profile copy and credentials
Click "Let's talk" button to scroll to Contact section (#contact)
Click "See the work" button to scroll to Projects section (#work)

features.name: Interactive Services Accordion
features.description: Expandable service items displaying title, description, and visual previews
user_interactions: Hover or click on service item to expand details
View service title, tagline, and preview imagery

features.name: Work & Projects Showcase
features.description: Editorial showcase of featured client projects with live links
user_interactions: View project title, client tag, description, and UI mockup
Click "Visit Live Website" external link
Click "Let's talk" CTA button

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: Interactive lead capture form with client-side validation and server API persistence
user_interactions: Fill in Name field
Fill in Email address field
Click Submit button to send message
See instant confirmation message upon success
See inline error feedback if fields are blank or invalid
Click "Send another" to reset the form
Hover over headline text to see orange color transition
Hover over avatar thumbnail to see alternate portrait swap
